content.what_it_is: MATLAB interactive animation script for the FUNWAVE-TVD rip_2d case plotting eta, mean-flow vorticity and depth+velocity vectors. Loads depth_a15.txt from ../bathy/ (L5), grid coordinates hard-coded dx=1 (x=[0:m-1]*1, L8) and dy=2 (y=[0:n-1]*2, L9), 8x5 inch figure (L12-L14). Snapshot range is taken interactively via input('nstart')/input('nend') (L16-L17; comment notes previous revision used nstart=280, L19). Per snapshot (L22-L91): loads time-averaged velocities umean_, vmean_, plus eta_ and mask_ (L27-L30), masks all fields where mask<1 (L31-L35). Three panels with window ax=[0 250 0 500] (L37): (1) eta pcolor, caxis [-0.6 1.2], jet, south colorbar labeled eta (m) (L40-L52); (2) vorticity [w w_ang]=curl(xx,yy,u,v) (L57), pcolor caxis [-.055 .06], colorbar 'vorticity (s^{-1})', dashed black reference line at x=140 spanning y 0-2000 (L59-L70); (3) contourf of -dep with 10 levels, colorbar 'depth (m)', caxis set twice ([-12 0] L75, then [-12 2.5] L80), overlaid quiver of u,v subsampled every 6 points scaled by s=20 in black (L82-L85). pause(0.1) between frames (L90). Nothing is saved to file.

unresolved: dep is masked in-place with the first snapshot's mask (L33) and never reloaded, so later snapshots inherit accumulated NaN holes from all previous masks
caxis for panel 3 is set to [-12 0] (L75) then overridden to [-12 2.5] (L80); the intended range is ambiguous
the vorticity panel uses time-averaged umean/vmean (L27-L28) while panel 1 shows instantaneous eta; the mixing of averaged and instantaneous fields is by design of the output but not commented
the dashed line at x=140 (L67) presumably marks the bar/rip-channel location; derivation not in this file
